tasks.name: Project Setup and Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize the PaperTrail project with proper directory structure, configuration files, and development environment setup. This includes setting up the monorepo structure, installing dependencies, configuring TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and establishing the basic project architecture.
tasks.notes: Focus on production-ready setup with proper development tooling and deployment preparation

relatedFiles.description: Frontend package configuration with Next.js and dependencies

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Create monorepo structure with frontend (Next.js) and backend (FastAPI) directories
2. Initialize package.json for frontend with Next.js 15+, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
3. Set up Python virtual environment with FastAPI, Neo4j driver, FAISS
4. Configure TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier for code quality
5. Set up Docker containers for development environment
6. Create basic CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
7. Configure environment variables and secrets management
tasks.verificationCriteria: Project structure is properly organized, all dependencies are installed, development environment runs successfully, and CI/CD pipeline is functional
tasks.analysisResult: Build PaperTrail: A comprehensive Graph-RAG + Multi-Agent System for research synthesis that processes academic papers, builds knowledge graphs, and provides intelligent analysis through specialized AI agents. The system should handle PDF uploads, extract entities and relationships, build Neo4j knowledge graphs, and orchestrate multiple agents (Synthesizer, Critic, Connector) for deep research analysis. The goal is to reduce research synthesis time by 60% while surfacing 3x more conceptual connections between papers.

tasks.name: PDF Processing Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement the PDF processing pipeline that extracts text, sections, and metadata from academic papers. This includes PDF parsing with PyMuPDF/pdfplumber, text extraction with confidence scoring, and structured data extraction for different paper sections.
tasks.notes: Focus on robust PDF processing with fallback mechanisms for various PDF formats
tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Implement PDF parsing with PyMuPDF for text extraction
2. Add pdfplumber for enhanced table and figure extraction
3. Create section parser for Abstract, Methods, Results, Conclusions
4. Implement citation extraction and parsing
5. Add confidence scoring for extraction quality
6. Handle OCR for scanned papers with Tesseract
7. Create metadata extraction (authors, dates, journals)
8. Implement batch processing for multiple PDFs
9. Add error handling for corrupted or unreadable PDFs
tasks.verificationCriteria: PDF processing extracts text accurately, handles various PDF formats, extracts sections properly, and processes citations correctly

4. Add confidence scoring for extracted entities and relationships
5. Create entity normalization and deduplication
6. Implement batch processing for multiple papers
7. Add fallback mechanisms for API failures
8. Create entity linking across papers
9. Implement relationship strength scoring
